title: Field table
description: Label and value rows as one ruled table, each row saying where its value came from. A row nobody filled prints blank and, unless the part says otherwise, is listed to complete under its own label.

rows.description: [{ label, value, source }]: value null when nobody gave it; source run, reviewer, scene, table or fixed.

listBlanks.description: List each blank row to complete under its label.

toComplete.description: More items to complete, in the part's own words.
